summary: July CPI landed Wednesday and July PPI hit this morning, completing the week's inflation data gauntlet. With three FOMC members having dissented in favor of a rate hike at the July meeting, the September decision is now a toss-up — markets are pricing roughly a 55% chance of a quarter-point hike.
tweet: July CPI and PPI are in, and a divided Fed has September's rate decision at a coin flip — equities are holding, bonds are hurting, and gold is catching the uncertainty bid.
